description: Build TournamentCard, TournamentBracket, and BracketModal components. Add tournament showcase section to games page. Implement bracket tree visualization and live match updates.
steps: Create lib/flowternity/tournament-bracket-utils.js: functions generateBracketJSON(matches, totalRounds, currentRound) and calculateBracketLayout(rounds) for SVG positioning

Create components/games-hub/tournament-card.js: displays status badge (Signups Open, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled), entry fee, prize pool, participant count progress bar, countdown timer if signups closing soon, 'View Bracket' and 'Join' buttons

Create components/games-hub/tournament-bracket.js: renders SVG/canvas bracket tree, shows current round highlighted, match results (seed 1 vs seed 2, score if completed), mobile horizontal scroll, desktop full view
Create modal wrapper: DialogContent with TournamentBracket + tournament details (prize pool, participants, dates, rules)
Add TournamentShowcase section to app/games/page.js: grid of 2-3 featured tournaments, fetch GET /api/tournaments?limit=5&status=signups_open,in_progress
Implement WebSocket subscription for match score updates in bracket (bonus: FEAT-012 prerequisite)
acceptance_criteria: TournamentCard renders all fields: status badge, entry fee, prize pool, participant progress
Click 'View Bracket' opens modal with bracket visualization
Bracket displays all matches with correct round grouping
Bracket responsive: scrollable on mobile, full view on desktop
Status badge colors and text correct for each status
Countdown timer displays if signups closing soon
Pagination works: can paginate through tournament list
verification: Load /games page, scroll to tournament section
Verify tournament cards render with status, entry fee, progress
Click 'View Bracket' on a tournament, modal opens with bracket
Verify bracket shows all matches, current round highlighted
Resize to mobile, verify bracket scrollable horizontally
Test each status (Signups Open, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled)
Verify countdown timer displays for tournaments with near signup close time
